title: Germany 5-Year Bobl reopening (EUR 5.0bn, DE000BU25075) — the day before the Bund 30Y multi-ISIN auction and CPI
source: EST: deutsche-finanzagentur.de Press Release No. 8 on 24 September 2026, "Issues planned by the Federal government in the fourth quarter of 2026" (2026_09_24_PM_08_Issues_planned_by_the_Federal_government_for_the_4th_quarter_2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 143,466 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-30), Annex 1: "Tue, 13-Oct-2026 | Bobl 5 R | 5,000 | 08-Oct-2031 | DE000BU25075 | 2.90%" — a reopening of the same 5-year Federal note (Bundesobligation) already tapped repeatedly this year (also reopened 21-Sep-2026 per the press index, and scheduled again 03-Nov and 01-Dec per the same Annex). Discovered during this session's adjacency sweep for bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14, one calendar day before that auction and one day before CPI (cpi-2026-10-14, confirmed, high); it falls inside the standard 5-day corridor and was not previously on this calendar. Filed estimate on the same mechanical count as every German-debt-office entry on this calendar: market-events-data.ts defines no confirmed source prefix for a non-US sovereign debt office. The date and ISIN are not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-30
notes: Proposed during bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14's 2026-09-30 pulse-check adjacency sweep. A routine 5-year Federal note (Bobl) reopening, EUR 5.0bn, DE000BU25075 (2.90%, maturing 2031-10-08) — the same ISIN this quarter's other Bobl taps reopen. No tracked symbol carries euro-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED; impact is tiered low on the same basis as every other German-debt-office entry on this calendar. Worth tracking mainly as same-week context for bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14's own read of the day (a 5Y supply print landing one session before the 30Y multi-ISIN auction and CPI). Other German auction dates in the same Annex 1 (Schatz new issue 2026-10-06, Bund 7Y new issue 2026-10-07, a green issue 2026-10-20, Bund 10Y reopening 2026-10-28) sit outside the 5-day adjacency corridor around 2026-10-14 and are not filed here. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
